extDescription.message: SWD Audit risk badges on token pages, an audit popup for any token or transaction, and warnings on known phishing sites.

level_info.message: no risk found by the rules

warnHigh.message: Serious risks found. Do not buy or approve this token unless you understand them.

warnMedium.message: Some risks found. Read the report before you trade.

phishBody.message: SWD Guard's list says this site imitates a crypto project to steal wallets or coins.

phishNever.message: Never type your seed phrase or private key, and do not connect or sign anything here.

popupInputHint.message: Solana addresses and signatures are detected automatically; for 0x… pick the EVM chain.

popupBadInput.message: Not an address, transaction hash or supported link.

popupNotListed.message: Not on SWD Guard's phishing list (that alone does not prove it is safe).

lookalikeTitle.message: Looks like SWD, but is not an official SWD site

lookalikeBody.message: Official SWD sites end in sawasdeecoin.com.

txNotFound.message: Transaction not found yet. Try again in a few seconds.

optBadges.message: Show the SWD Audit badge on token pages (Solscan, Jupiter, Birdeye, DEX Screener, pump.fun)

optUpdatedList.message: Download the updated phishing list once a day

optUpdatedListHint.message: A plain list of domain names from SWD's public GitHub repository. Only the file is downloaded; nothing about you is sent.

optAllSitesHint.message: Optional: let SWD Guard show the full-page warning on every domain of the updated list. Chrome asks for access to all sites for this; SWD Guard still runs only on listed domains and never reads page content.

optGrantAllSites.message: Allow warnings on all listed sites

privacyBody.message: SWD Guard sends only the token address or transaction hash you look at to the SWD Audit API (swd-zetaphy.sawasdeecoin.com), with no cookies and no identifiers. It never reads wallets, keys, passwords or page content, has no analytics and loads no remote code. Settings stay in your browser.
